'''Thint''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing in [[Camp Can'ali]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Thint at one point revealed to an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] the details of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka's]] excavation of [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison]].<ref name="TOR" />
